m: ava-dhāna n. attention, attentiveness, intentness, Kum. iv, 2; Śiś. ix, 11, &c., (cf. sāvadhana.)
a: avadhānaṃ 1 Attention, avadhānapare cakāra sā pralayāṃtonmiṣite vilocane Ku. 4. 2; avadhānaṃ dīyamānaṃ prārthaye Ve. 1;  intentness, attentiveness; dattāvadhānaḥ śṛṇoti hears attentively. 2 Devotion, care, carefulness; avadhānāt carefully or attentively; śṛṇuta janā avadhānāt kriyāmimāṃ kālidāsasya V. 1. 2. v. l.
